<info title="Mirror research main findings"><body>Design principles for smart mirror displays behind two-way glass, read from across rooms.</body>
<item>Text minimum 0.3° subtend for legibility</item>
<item>Keep centre clear for reflection visible</item>
<item>Black invisible: white text high contrast</item>
<item>Glance must complete in under 2 seconds</item>
<item>Animate only on change, motion draws eye</item>
<item>Cards work best from title alone for scan</item>
</info>
